annotations.title: One price watch by the signed link of its mail

description: What the link in a price-watch mail opens (/{locale}/hlidac?t=…), without an account: the product, status (pending | active | paused | cancelled), target_total and saved_total in the watch's currency, the delivery country, last_alert_at and `last_trigger` (when the watch last fired: total, target, shop and the captured_at of that price; null before the first), and `purpose` manage | confirm (the confirmation link of watch_product_price). No e-mail address, no other watch. Next: manage_price_watch with the same token.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.

t.description: The `t` parameter of the link in a price-watch mail (/{locale}/hlidac?t=…): the signed token of that one watch.
